shared_elements: schematic human figure(s) rendered in low relief on stone
incised linear signs/motifs covering a large surface
repeated small motifs arranged in rows or bands
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces bear shallow incised/relief markings and some form of schematic human figure, with small motifs distributed in roughly horizontal groupings. A shows a flat panel dominated by dense rows of repeated script-like signs above small frontal standing figures, whereas B is a three-dimensional human-shaped block whose back carries a few large curvilinear motifs (a ring, discs, arcs and a curved girdle band) in no linear sequence — no distinctive motif or relationship is shared.
